content: Tem mɛ bɑ Yudɑn bwese kɛrɑ wɛ̃, mɛn sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ mu yɔ̃rɑwɑ Edɔmun tem nɔɔ burɑ yerɔ. Mi ɡiɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɑtumɑ mi ɡɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ kpi. Yerɑ bɑ sokumɔ Sini.
Berɑ min nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ toruɑwɑ sɑɑ nim wɔ̃ku bɔruɡuun di
mɑ tɑ dɑ ɡunɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Akɑrɑbimuɔ kɑ Siniɔ sere kɑ Kɑdɛsi Bɑɑnɛɑɔ. Sɑɑ mɑɑ min di, tɑ dɑ Hɛsironiɔ kɑ Adɑriɔ sere kɑ Kɑɑkɑɑɔ.
Sɑɑ min di tɑ dɑ Asimɔɔn berɑ ɡiɑ n kɑ dɑ Eɡibitin dɑɑrɔ, mɑ tɑ dɑɑ te swĩi sere nim wɔ̃ku ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛɔ. Nɡe mɛyɑ Yudɑbɑn tem nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ nim wɔ̃ku bɔruɡuuwɑ ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑ mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru, n kɑ ɡirɑri mi Yuudɛnin dɑɑrɑ rɑ nim sure.
Sɑɑ min di, mɛn sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑn nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ dɑwɑ Bɛti Hoɡulɑɔ kɑ Bɛti Arɑbɑn sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeuɔ n kɑ ɡirɑri Bohɑnin kperɔ. Bohɑni wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Rubɛnin bii.

Sɑɑ min di, tɑ mɑɑ dɑ Debiriɔ, Akɔɔn wɔwɑn bɔkuɔ. Sɑɑ min di tɑ dɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ sere Giliɡɑlin bɔkuɔ, Adumimun ɡuurun deedeeru, yen dɑɑrun sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ, n kɑ dɑ Eni Semɛsin bwiin bɔkuɔ, sere kɑ Eni Roɡɛliɔ.

Sɑɑ min di, tɑ sɑrɑ tɑ dɑ Bɛni Hinɔmun wɔwɑɔ, Yebusin sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ, ye bɑ mɑɑ sokumɔ Yerusɑlɛmu, kɑ sere ɡuu ni nu wɑ̃ɑ wɔwɑ yen sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ, kɑ mi Refɑn wɔwɑ yɑ yɔ̃rɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ.
Sɑɑ mɑɑ min di tɑ dɑ tɑ Nɛfitoɑn bwii ɡirɑri n kɑ dɑ wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ ɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Eforoniɔ, n kɑ mɑɑ dɑ sere Bɑlɑɔ ye bɑ mɑɑ sokumɔ Yɑrimun wuu.
Sɑɑ Bɑlɑn di, tɑ mɑɑ dɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ n kɑ ɡirɑri Seirin ɡuuru ɡiɑ kɑ ɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Yɑrimun sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ Kɛsɑloniɔ, mɑ tɑ dɑ Bɛti Semɛsiɔ kɑ Tinnɑɔ,
kɑ Ekoronin sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ, n kɑ dɑ Sikoroniɔ kɑ ɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Bɑlɑ ɡiɑ sere Yɑbunɛɛliɔ mɑ tɑ yɔ̃rɑ nim wɔ̃ku ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛɔ.
Nim wɔ̃ku ɡeyɑ, ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑ tem mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ Yudɑbɑn tem mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yenu yi yi.
Bɑ Kɑlɛbu Yɛfunɛn bii Yudɑbɑn tem ɡɑm wɛ̃ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u Yosue sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Bɑ nùn Aribɑn wuu wɛ̃ ye bɑ mɑɑ mɔ̀ Heboroni. Aribɑ wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Anɑkibɑn sikɑdo.
Kɑlɛbu wi, u Anɑkibɑn bwesenu itɑ ɡirɑ. Berɑ Sesɑibɑ kɑ Akimɑnibɑ kɑ sere Tɑlimɑibɑ.
Heboronin diyɑ u seewɑ u dɑ u Debiriɡibu wɔri. Wuu ɡerɑ bɑ rɑ rɑɑ soku Sefɛɛn wuu.
Mɑ Kɑlɛbu u nɛɛ, wi u kpĩɑ u Sefɛɛn wuu kɑmiɑ, yɛ̃rowɑ u koo win bii wɔndiɑ Akusɑ kɛ̃ u suɑ kurɔ.
Yerɑ Otiniɛli, Kɑlɛbun mɔɔ Kenɑsin bii, u wuu ɡe kɑmiɑ. Mɑ Kɑlɛbu u nùn win bii wɔndiɑ wi wɛ̃ kurɔ.

Sɑnɑm mɛ kurɔ wi, u duɑ Otiniɛlin yɛnuɔ u kpɑ, yerɑ u nùn bwisi kɑ̃ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ tem bikiɑ nɛn tundon mi. Adɑmɑ kurɔ win tii u dɑ win tundo Kɑlɛbun mi. Ye u turɑ mi, u sɑrɑ sɑɑ win kɛtɛkun di. Yerɑ Kɑlɛbu u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ ɑ kĩ.
Mɑ u wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ suuru koowo ɑ mɑn bwii kɛ̃. Domi berɑ ye ɑ mɑn wɛ̃ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ, nim sɑri mi. Mɑ Kɑlɛbu u nùn bwii wɛ̃ yi yi wɑ̃ɑ ɡuunɔ kɑ wɔwɑɔ.
Tem mɛ bɑ siɑ siɑ mini kpurowɑ mu kuɑ Yudɑn bwese kɛrɑn tubi.
Wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ Edɔmun tem nɔɔ burɑ yeru ɡiɑ Yudɑbɑn tem sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ, siyɑ Kɑbisɛɛli, kɑ Edɛɛ kɑ Yɑɡuri,
kɑ Kinɑ, kɑ Dimɔnɑ, kɑ Adɑdɑ,
kɑ Kedɛsi, kɑ Hɑsori, kɑ Itinɑni,
kɑ Sifu, kɑ Telɛmu, kɑ Beɑlɔtu,
kɑ Hɑsori Hɑdɑtɑ, kɑ Keriɔtu Hɛsironi ye bɑ mɑɑ sokumɔ Hɑsori,
kɑ Amɑmu, kɑ Semɑ, kɑ Mɔlɑdɑ,
kɑ Hɑsori Gɑdɑ, kɑ Hɛsimɔɔ, kɑ Bɛti Pɑlɛti,
kɑ Hɑsɑɑ Suɑli, kɑ Beri Sebɑ, kɑ Bisotiɑ,
kɑ Bɑlɑ, kɑ Iyimu, kɑ Asɛmu,
kɑ Ɛlitolɑdi, kɑ Kesili, kɑ Hɔɔmɑ,
kɑ Sikilɑɡi, kɑ Mɑdimɑnɑ, kɑ Sɑnsɑnɑ,
kɑ Lebɑɔti, kɑ Silimu, kɑ Aini, kɑ Rimɔɔ. Wuu si kpuro su kuɑwɑ tɛnɑ tiɑ sɑri, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Wuu si su mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɔwɑ sɔɔ, siyɑ Ɛsitɑoli, kɑ Soreɑ, kɑ Asinɑ,
kɑ Sɑnɔɑ, kɑ Eni Gɑnimu, kɑ Tɑpuɑ, kɑ Enɑmu,
kɑ Yɑɑmuti, kɑ Adulɑmu, kɑ Soko, kɑ Asekɑ,
kɑ Sɑɑrɑimu, kɑ Aditɑimu, kɑ Gederɑ, kɑ Gederɔtɑimu. Si mɑɑ, su kuɑwɑ wɔkurɑ nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Kɑ Senɑni, kɑ Hɑdɑsɑ, kɑ Miɡidɑli Gɑdi,
kɑ Dilɑni, kɑ Misipe, kɑ Yokutɛɛli,
kɑ Lɑkisi, kɑ Bosikɑti, kɑ Eɡoloni,
kɑ Kɑboni, kɑ Lɑsimɑsi, kɑ Kitilisi,
kɑ Gederɔtu, kɑ Bɛti Dɑɡoni, kɑ Nɑɑmɑ, kɑ Mɑkedɑ. Si mɑɑ, su kuɑwɑ mi wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ tiɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Kɑ mɑɑ Libinɑ, kɑ Etɛɛ, kɑ Asɑni,
kɑ Yifutɑ, kɑ Asinɑ, kɑ Nɛsibu,
kɑ Keilɑ, kɑ Akisibu, kɑ Mɑresɑ. Mɑ si kpuro su mɑɑ kuɑ nɔɔbɑ nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Kɑ mɑɑ Ekoroni, ye kɑ yen wuu mɑrosu kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Kɑ sere wuu mɑrosu kɑ bɑru kpɑɑnu ni nu kɑ Asidɔdu sikerenɛ kɑ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ Ekoroni kɑ nim wɔ̃ku ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛn bɑɑ sɔɔ,
kɑ Asidɔdu, kɑ Gɑsɑ, kɑ sin wuu mɑrosu kɑ bɑru kpɑɑnu, n kɑ ɡirɑri Eɡibitin dɑɑrɔ sere n kɑ dɑ nim wɔ̃ku ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛɔ.
Wuu si su mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡuunɔ, siyɑ Sɑmiri kɑ Yɑtiri kɑ Soko,
kɑ Dɑnɑ, kɑ Sɑnɑn wuu, ɡe bɑ mɑɑ mɔ̀ Debiri,
kɑ Anɑbu, kɑ Ɛsitemɔɑ, kɑ Animu,
kɑ Gosɛni, kɑ Holoni, kɑ Gilo. Mɑ si, su mɑɑ kuɑ wɔkurɑ tiɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Kɑ Arɑbu, kɑ Dumɑ, kɑ Eseɑni,
kɑ Yɑnumu, kɑ Bɛti Tɑpuɑ, kɑ Afɛki,
kɑ Humutɑ, kɑ Aribɑn wuu ɡe bɑ mɑɑ mɔ̀ Heboroni, kɑ Siori. Mɑ si kpuro su mɑɑ kuɑ nɔɔbɑ nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Kɑ mɑɑ Mɑoni, kɑ Kɑɑmɛli, kɑ Sifu, kɑ Yutɑ,
kɑ Yisirɛɛli, kɑ Yokudeɑmu, kɑ Sɑnɔɑ,
kɑ Kɑɛni, kɑ Gibeɑ, kɑ Tinnɑ. Si kpuro su mɑɑ kuɑ wɔkuru, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Kɑ sere mɑɑ Hɑlulu, kɑ Bɛti Suri, kɑ Gedori,
kɑ Mɑrɑti, kɑ Bɛti Anɔtu, kɑ Eletekonu. Si kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Kɑ sere mɑɑ Bɑɑlin wuu ɡe bɑ mɑɑ mɔ̀ Yɑrimun wuu, kɑ Rɑbɑ. Mɑ si, su mɑɑ kuɑ yiru, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ berɑ mi ɡɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ kpi, siyɑ Bɛti Arɑbɑ, kɑ Midini, kɑ Sekɑkɑ,
kɑ Nibusɑni, kɑ wuu mi bɔrɑ wɑ̃ɑ, kɑ Eni Enɡɛdi. Si kpuro su kuɑwɑ wusu nɔɔbɑ tiɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Adɑmɑ Yudɑn bibun bweseru, bɑ ǹ kpĩɑ bɑ Yebusibɑ ɡire be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔn ɡisɔ, kɑ Yudɑbɑ sɑnnu.
Tem mɛ bɑ Efɑrɑimu
kɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛri wɛ̃
